profile.ja: 五車学園の学生。ふうま弾正による反乱の際に両親を失った孤児であり、当初は親と共に死亡したと思われていた。実は両親に命がけで逃がされたが、その先で闇組織に攫われ、対魔忍とは知られぬまま手先として育てられ利用されていた。成長して忍術が発現すると、魔族の血筋だと思われて暗殺や拷問などを命じられるようになり、血に濡れた子供時代を過ごした。その凄惨な経験を経て、攫われる前の記憶を失っていて、自身を魔族だと思い込むうちに半ば魔族覚醒し、心までも闇に呑まれる寸前のところで、組織を討伐しに来た対魔忍に保護される。それ以来、五車学園に通って術の制御と対魔忍としての生き方を学ぶようになった。戸惑いはあったが生活環境は格段によくなった事もあり、前向きに対魔忍を目指そうと決意している。しかし、まだ心は闇に囚われかけており、絶望や激しい怒りなどを抱くと魔が心身を蝕んでしまう。また、悪意渦巻く世界で生きてきたために人を信頼し愛する事が苦手だが、同時に信頼と愛に飢えてもいる。ためらいなく対魔忍の正義を信奉する学園のクラスメイトには、呆れと憧れの両方を複雑に感じている。
profile.en: She is a student at Gosha Academy. An orphan who lost her parents during Fuuma Danjo's rebellion, she was initially thought to have died with them. In fact, her parents risked their lives to escape with her, but she was later kidnapped by a dark organization and raised as a tool, unaware of the Taimanin. When her ninja abilities manifested, she was mistaken for having demon blood and was ordered to carry out assassinations and torture, spending a childhood drenched in blood. After those horrific experiences, she lost her memories from before the kidnapping, came to believe she was a demon, and partially awakened to her demonic nature, nearly having her heart consumed by darkness before being rescued by Taimanin who came to defeat the organization. Since then she has attended Gosha Academy to learn to control her techniques and how to live as a Taimanin. Though she was initially confused, her living conditions have improved dramatically, and she has resolved to pursue becoming a Taimanin with a positive outlook. However, her heart still teeters on the edge of darkness, and despair or intense anger allow the demon within to corrode her body and mind. Having lived in a world full of malice, she struggles to trust and love others, yet she also starves for trust and affection. She feels a complex mix of exasperation and admiration toward her classmates who unflinchingly uphold Taimanin justice.

text.ja: 朽木真妃留よ。へえ、知っている……？　そう、だからそんなに腰が引けているのね。大丈夫よ、あなた個人にはなんとも思ってないわ
text.en: Kutsuki Mahiru here. Huh, you know…? Yeah, that's why you're so hesitant. It's fine—I don't really think anything of you personally.

text.ja: 私に関わってもいいの？　いつ魔族と化すか、分からないわよ？　特に、あなたの隣では、ね……
text.en: Is it okay for me to get involved with you? You never know when I might turn into a demon, right? Especially when I'm by your side…

text.ja: アサギ校長には感謝しているわ。あの人がいなければ、私、助け出されても前向きには生きられなかったでしょうね……あなたも、そう？
text.en: I'm grateful to Principal Asagi. If that person hadn't been there, even if I'd been rescued I don't think I could have lived positively… you feel the same, don't you?

text.ja: 任務の後、個人的な買い物に出てもいいかしら？　……いえ、付き添いは結構よ。友……クラスの子へのお土産なの。一人で選びたいわ
text.en: After the mission, may I go out for some personal shopping? …No, I don't need an escort. It's a souvenir for a classmate. I want to pick it out alone.

text.ja: 正義の対魔忍、ね……本当にそうなのかしら。私たちのこの力……いつ魔に落ちてもおかしくない、そんな者たちが？
text.en: A righteous Taimanin, huh… I wonder if that's really true. Our power… could fall to darkness at any moment—people like us?

text.ja: 今の生活は好きよ。だからこそ近づき過ぎて壊したくないわ。ヤマアラシのジレンマね。そう、あれは適切な距離を見つける話なのよ
text.en: I love my current life, which is exactly why I don't want to get too close and ruin it. It's the porcupine dilemma—finding the right distance.

text.ja: いいのかしら、罪に手を染めた私なんかがこんな風に暮らして……ふふ、バレたかしら？　そうね、あなたにそう言わせたくて言ったのよ
text.en: I wonder if it's okay for someone like me, stained by sin, to live like this… Heh, did I get caught? Yeah, I said it just so you'd say it back to me.

text.ja: うふふふふ、やっぱりあなたも、こういう事、したいのねぇ……いいのよ分かっているから。ちゅっ、じゅるぅ、ちゅっちゅ、ふふふ……
text.en: Hehehe, I knew you wanted this too… It's fine, I understand. *kiss* *slurp* *kiss kiss* hehe…

text.ja: くぅぅ……優しくしないで、おかしくなっちゃう……ああんっ、しないでって言ってるのに……意地悪だけど、優しい人……ふあぁっ！
text.en: Kuu… Don't be gentle, it'll drive me crazy… Ahh, even though I told you not to… you're cruel but kind… Faa!

text.ja: どんな手管がお好みかしらぁ？　君臨する女王？　それとも傅く奴隷？　んはぁぁ、どっちもこなせるわ……あぁっ、散々仕込まれたもの
text.en: What kind of technique do you prefer? A reigning queen? Or a devoted slave? Hmm, I can handle both… Ah, after all that training.
